meta_data.base_class: Provide style suggestions for specific <indoor spaces> in a house - refers to independent areas within a building that can be decorated and designed in different styles.

tool_template.name: Style_Advisor_For_<class>
tool_template.description: Provide style advice for a <class> based on customer preferences and <class> characteristics.

customer_style.description: The customer's preferred style, such as 'industrial' or 'bohemian', with a length between 3 and 20 characters.

room_characteristics.description: A description of the <class>'s characteristics, such as 'spacious' or 'cozy'.

budget_limit.description: The maximum budget available for styling the <class>.

color_palette.description: Preferred color palette for the <class>, such as 'monochrome' or 'pastel'.

functionality_priority.description: The primary functionality focus for the <class>, such as 'entertainment', 'relaxation' or 'work'.

seasonal_theme.description: The preferred seasonal theme for the <class>, options include 'spring', 'summer', 'autumn', and 'winter'.

material_preference.description: Preferred materials for furniture and decorations in the <class>, such as 'wood' or 'metal'.
